mapper.insert: insert into mq_event ( event_id, event_type, payload, status ) values ( #{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status} )
mapper.select: select id, event_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, create_time, update_time from mq_event where status = 0 order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update mq_event set status = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
update mq_event set status = 2, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
update mq_event set retry_count = retry_count + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
